method: Both actual retained PNGs were displayed using view_image and inspected. Separate Python verification rechecked image bytes, dimensions, six font assets and two capture sources against the immutable Git source.

observations: Complete worksheet editor backdrop, including the sheet grid and bottom worksheet selector, is visible behind the modal.
Rename worksheet title, Worksheet name label and duplicate value Reference are readable with real glyphs.
The red unique-name validation text wraps legibly inside the dialog without clipping.
Cancel and Rename actions are visible and readable; real toolbar icons are present.
Arabic menu and ribbon text display recognizable joined glyphs with the intended RTL chrome.
The responsive title is intentionally elided while the visible toolbar actions remain available.
The bottom worksheet row shows the authored Budget label on the right and visible selector arrow and rename pencil on the left.
The narrow grid and horizontal scrollbar remain visible; no missing-font boxes or clipped worksheet controls are observed.

nonblocking_capture_detail: Both test captures retain the small diagonal Flutter debug marker at a top corner. They are test captures, not release screenshots.
scope: Visual inspection of two saved font-backed complete-host captures. This does not exercise interactions, physical devices, native macOS toolbar behavior, external Office rendering or broader UI acceptance.
